name: alert-system
description: Multi-channel alert notification system with email and Slack support

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.db:init: cd backend && npm run dev -- src/database.ts
